decisionsTitle: The race-day desk's list folds by state: «De ridicat numărul» first, a search opening what it found, a press back on its row with its section open
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19:** «Pe ziua cursei trebuie să fac secțiuni collapsible în funcție de status» — on race day the desk's list must fold by state.

**Decision.** The desk's list («Ziua cursei» → «Prezența», `/admin/checkin`) is one fold per state, in the table's working order — what the volunteer does first comes first —, each a level-3 `Panel` (the house's boxed fold, its 44-pixel summary a heading) whose summary says its words and the count of its rows, «De ridicat numărul (12)»:

1. «De ridicat numărul» / “To pick up” — confirmed, not checked in. Open on every arrival (`primary`: what the desk is for).
2. «Fără declarație semnată» / “Declaration not signed” — `PENDING_DECLARATION`, the rows «Confirmă pe hârtie» is pressed on. Open while it has rows (`attention`).
3. «Prezenți» / “Present” — confirmed and checked in. Closed.
4. «Adresă neconfirmată» / “Address not confirmed” — `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION`. Closed.
5. «Ofertă de loc deschisă» / “Place offered” — `WAITLIST_OFFERED`. Closed.
6. «Pe lista de așteptare» / “On the waiting list” — `WAITLISTED`, in the state's own words (`REGISTRATION_STATUS_LABEL`, §35). Closed.
7. «Anulate sau expirate» / “Cancelled or expired” — drawn only when a race number found such a row (BR-REQ-037-08 criterion 8, §311). Open (`attention`: a printed bib may have to come out of the pile).

A section with no rows is not drawn; inside each, the rows keep the list's order (by name, then id). The rule is one module, `registrations/domain/desk-sections.ts` (`deskSectionOf`, `deskSections`); a row that is over is in the last section whatever else it carries. Each section wears a glyph from `panel-glyphs.ts` — the bib, the paper, the person-with-tick, the address, the seat (`placeOffered`, added: the picture the state's chip wears), the hourglass, the row that is over —, so a column of closed sections reads by picture too. Server Components only: every section is a `<details>`, so it folds before hydration and with JavaScript off.

**The count is of the real rows.** A test registration is drawn in its section, labelled «Test», and left out of the section's number, as the desk's counters above the list leave it out (§30, §420): the sections' numbers and the counters agree.

**A search** — a name fragment or a number — draws only the sections it found somebody in, each open (`inUse`); **a typed code** names one runner, drawn alone as before, with no section.

**The way back after a press.** Every press on a row of the list — «Marchează prezent», «Anulează prezența», «Salvează nr.», «Confirmă pe hârtie», «Dă-i un loc», «Elită și BIB», «Înscrie la tombolă» — and the walk-in's «Adaugă înscrierea» opened from the desk come back with the event, the search and the row in the address (`row=<id>`, a registration's id and nothing about the person), landing on the row (`#reg-<id>`, `list-row.ts#listReturnAnchor`, as a row's press on the registrations list has since §943) when the press went through and on the alert when it was refused. The server draws open the section that holds the row now, whatever moved it — a check-in lands in «Prezenți», a paper confirmation on a full race in «Pe lista de așteptare» (`saved`, or `refused`) —, because a redirect to the same page runs no `OpenFoldFromHash`; the row's `<li>` carries the id, so a full load lands there too. The outcome is the toast's to say: the desk's raffle sign-up, which said it only in the alert, now flashes its toast as well when it comes back to a row of the list.

**Unchanged.** The rows' content and verbs, the counters, the search's results and its 200-row cap, the scanned page `/admin/checkin/<code>` (one row, no section, its presses back to its alert), and the desk of a race that is over: the sections fold the same, every row read-only.

**Refused.** Open states kept in the browser (the desk works before hydration; a `<details>` is the fold); counting test registrations in a section's number (it would disagree with the counters and break §30); opening every section after a press (the volunteer would lose the list's shape); landing on the alert after a press that went through (with the sections open above, the row would be out of sight — the toast says the outcome).

**Verification.** Unit `tests/unit/registrations/desk-sections.test.ts` (the order, the states, why each opens, the count, the words in both catalogues); integration `tests/integration/registrations/race-day-desk-sections.test.ts` (the page on a real database: every section and its count, the counters, a name search, a number, a code, the scanned page, a race that is over, both languages, and each press's way back through the real actions — check-in, undo, a saved number, a paper confirmation with a place and on a full race, the elite mark, the walk-in, a refusal); `tests/integration/volunteers/raffle-tab-screens.test.ts` (the desk's sign-up back on its row with its toast); e2e `tests/e2e/race-day-sections.spec.ts` at 320 pixels and on a desktop.
changelogLine: - **The race-day desk folds by state** — «Prezența» lists its runners in sections, in working order: «De ridicat numărul» and «Fără declarație semnată» open, «Prezenți», «Adresă neconfirmată», «Ofertă de loc deschisă» and «Pe lista de așteptare» folded, each with how many; a search opens what it found, and a press comes back to its row, its section open. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the desk's list for a chosen event, when it is drawn without a typed code, then its rows stand in folding sections, one per state, in this order — «De ridicat numărul» (confirmed, not checked in), «Fără declarație semnată» (`PENDING_DECLARATION`), «Prezenți» (confirmed, checked in), «Adresă neconfirmată» (`PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION`), «Ofertă de loc deschisă» (`WAITLIST_OFFERED`), «Pe lista de așteptare» (`WAITLISTED`) and, only when a race number found one, «Anulate sau expirate» —, each a `<details>` whose 44-pixel summary is a level-3 heading «<words> (N)», N its rows that are not test registrations; a section with no rows is not drawn; the rows inside keep the list's order; «De ridicat numărul», «Fără declarație semnată» and «Anulate sau expirate» are drawn open and the others closed; the counters above the list are as before; in both languages (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a search at the desk — a name fragment or a race number —, when the list is drawn, then only the sections holding a match are drawn, each open; given a typed code, then the one registration it names is drawn alone, with no section, as before (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a press on a row of the desk's list — «Marchează prezent», «Anulează prezența», «Salvează nr.», «Confirmă pe hârtie», «Dă-i un loc», «Elită și BIB», «Înscrie la tombolă» — or the walk-in's entry opened from the desk, when the press comes back, then the address carries the event, the search and the row (`row=<id>`) and lands on the row (`#reg-<id>`) when the press went through, on the alert when it was refused; the page draws open the section that now holds the row — a check-in in «Prezenți», a paper confirmation on a full race in «Pe lista de așteptare» — and no other beyond those open by default; a press on the scanned page comes back to that page as before (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the race-day desk folds by state, a press back on its row with its section open
